reviewed_by: Codex concurrent Ask Nebula and conversation activity review
reason: Selects the popup component and provider lifecycle regressions, the Core-owned saved-conversation activity endpoint, all eight permanent production-browser profiles for both the popup and conversation-list journeys, and the focused real-Core popup journey. This covers opening a second independent temporary branch while the first response remains active, preserving streamed Markdown agent results through completion, per-window close and cleanup, responsive positioning, accessible motion-based working/waiting/idle markers including reduced-motion CSS, durable branch isolation, and the unchanged source conversation.
exclusions: No full suites. Provider and harness adapters, native code, and unrelated assistant/workspace journeys are unchanged, so native and unrelated backend/frontend tests are excluded. The focused API test proves Core state classification and temporary-session exclusion; selected browser profiles prove the operator-visible states and responsive popup workflow. A production build is run separately because it is a build gate, not a test-selection layer. Physical-device execution is unavailable locally and is not represented by a substituted resized browser claim.
